scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,white "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c red,white "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
